name: Rejoicing In The Truth
overview: Rejoicing in the truth centers on embracing God's Word as the ultimate standard of holiness and love. Scripture calls believers to love one another sincerely as Christ loved us, demonstrating this truth in both word and deed. Through sanctification by God's truth, believers grow into Christ, the head, by speaking truth with love and rejecting the works of darkness. This joyful commitment to truth reflects God's commendable love shown in Christ’s sacrificial death for sinners.
